input.task: Which filing is selected in the Filing lab, and what does the appendix footnote say?

provenance: ADR-027 Decision 2 / ADR-028: `select_option` in BOTH modes (this case is mode B, the loop twin is loop-drives-a-fetch-then-render-page). Its postcondition is a readback of the selected option, the same self-verification `fill` gets — no authored `expected_state` is needed and `postcondition_ok` is true because the browser was asked what is selected, not because the call returned. The option is named by its LABEL, which is what a model reads off an observation; the `value` attribute (`msft-2025`) is never in one.
